verses.english: The Day when no soul will avail another soul anything; and the decision on that Day is Allah’s.
Woe to the defrauders.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا اكۡتَالُوۡا عَلَي النَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُوۡنَؗۖ‏
verses.english: Those who, when they take a measure from people, they take in full.
But when they measure or weigh to others, they cheat.
Do these not know that they will be resurrected?
For a Great Day?
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
verses.indopak: كَلَّا٘ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡفُجَّارِ لَفِيۡ سِجِّيۡنٍؕ‏
verses.english: Not at all. The record of the wicked is in Sijjeen.
But how can you know what Sijjeen is?
A numerical book.
Woe on that Day to the deniers.
Those who deny the Day of Reckoning.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهٖ٘ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ اَثِيۡمٍۙ‏
verses.english: But none denies it except the sinful aggressor.

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: اِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.english: When Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Legends of the ancients.”

verses.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
verses.indopak: كَلَّا بَلۡࣝ رَانَ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
verses.english: Not at all. Their hearts have become corroded by what they used to earn.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
verses.indopak: كَلَّا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ عَنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّمَحۡجُوۡبُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.english: Not at all. On that Day, they will be screened from their Lord.
Then they will roast in Hell.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.english: Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.indopak: كَلَّا٘ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡاَبۡرَارِ لَفِيۡ عِلِّيِّيۡنَؕ‏
verses.english: No indeed; the record of the righteous is in Elliyyeen.
But how can you know what Elliyyoon is?
A numerical book.
Witnessed by those brought near.
Indeed, the righteous will be amid bliss.
On thrones, looking on.
You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
They will be given to drink a sealed wine.

verses.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.indopak: خِتٰمُهٗ مِسۡكٌؕ وَفِيۡ ذٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ الۡمُتَنٰفِسُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.english: Whose seal is musk—this is what competitors should compete for.
Its mixture is of Tasneem.
A spring from which those brought near drink.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اَجۡرَمُوۡا كَانُوۡا مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَؗۖ‏
verses.english: Those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
And when they passed by them, they would wink at one another.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا انۡقَلَبُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهِمُ انۡقَلَبُوۡا فَكِهِيۡنَؗۖ‏
verses.english: And when they went back to their families, they would go back exulting.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا رَاَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّوۡنَۙ‏
verses.english: And if they saw them, they would say, “These people are lost.”
Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

verses.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.indopak: فَالۡيَوۡمَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مِنَ الۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.english: But on that Day, those who believed will laugh at the unbelievers.
On luxurious furnishings, looking on.

verses.arabic: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.indopak: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ الۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.english: Have the unbelievers been repaid for what they used to do?
When the sky is ruptured.
And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.
And when the earth is leveled out.
And casts out what is in it, and becomes empty.
And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verses.indopak: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ كَدۡحًا فَمُلٰقِيۡهِۚ‏
verses.english: O man! You are laboring towards your Lord, and you will meet Him.
As for him who is given his book in his right hand.
He will have an easy settlement.
And will return to his family delighted.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهٖۙ‏
verses.english: But as for him who is given his book behind his back.
He will call for death.
And will enter the Blaze.
He used to be happy among his family.
He thought he would never return.

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
verses.indopak: بَلٰ٘يۚۛ اِنَّ رَبَّهٗ كَانَ بِهٖ بَصِيۡرًاؕ‏
verses.english: In fact, his Lord was watching him.
I swear by the twilight.
And by the night, and what it covers.
And by the moon, as it grows full.
You will mount stage by stage.
What is the matter with them that they do not believe?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ لَا يَسۡجُدُوۡنَࣛؕ‏
verses.english: And when the Quran is read to them, they do not bow down?
In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.
But Allah knows what they hide inside.
So inform them of a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍࣖ‏
verses.english: Except those who believe and do good deeds; they will have an undiminished reward.
By the sky with the constellations.
And by the Promised Day.
And by the witness and the witnessed.
Destroyed were the People of the Trench.
The fire supplied with fuel.
While they sat around it.

verses.arabic: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
verses.indopak: وَّهُمۡ عَلٰي مَا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ بِالۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ شُهُوۡدٌؕ‏
verses.english: And were witnessing what they did to the believers.

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
verses.indopak: وَمَا نَقَمُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَمِيۡدِۙ‏
verses.english: They begrudged them only because they believed in Allah the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌؕ‏
verses.english: To Whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. Allah is witness over everything.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ فَتَنُوا الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوۡبُوۡا فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ الۡحَرِيۡقِؕ‏
verses.english: Those who tempt the believers, men and women, then do not repent; for them is the punishment of Hell; for them is the punishment of Burning.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٌ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ ذٰلِكَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡكَبِيۡرُؕ‏
verses.english: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph.
The onslaught of your Lord is severe.
It is He who begins and repeats.
And He is the Forgiving, the Loving.
Possessor of the Glorious Throne.
Doer of whatever He wills.
Has there come to you the story of the legions?
Of Pharaoh and Thamood?
In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.
And Allah encloses them from beyond.
In fact, it is a Glorious Quran.
In a Preserved Tablet.
By the sky and at-Tariq.
But what will let you know what at-Tariq is?
The Piercing Star.

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ
verses.indopak: اِنۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٌؕ‏
verses.english: There is no soul without a Protector over it.
Let man consider what he was created from.
He was created from gushing liquid.
Issuing from between the backbone and the breastbones.
He is certainly able to return him.
On the Day when the secrets are disclosed.

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ
verses.indopak: فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ قُوَّةٍ وَّلَا نَاصِرٍؕ‏
verses.english: He will have no strength, and no supporter.
By the sky that returns.
And the earth that cracks open.
It is a Decisive Word.
It is no joke.
They plot and scheme.
But I plot and scheme.
Therefore, give the blasphemers respite, a brief respite.
Praise the Name of your Lord, the Most High.
He who creates and regulates.
He who measures and guides.
He who produces the pasture.
And then turns it into light debris.
We will make you read, so do not forget.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ الۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفٰيؕ‏
verses.english: Except what Allah wills. He knows what is declared, and what is hidden.
We will ease you into the Easy Way.
So remind, if reminding helps.
The reverent will remember.
But the wretched will avoid it.
He who will enter the Gigantic Fire.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوۡتُ فِيۡهَا وَلَا يَحۡيٰيؕ‏
verses.english: Where he will neither die, nor live.
Successful is he who purifies himself.
And mentions the name of his Lord, and prays.
But you prefer the present life.
Though the Hereafter is better, and more lasting.
This is in the former scriptures.
The Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
Has there come to you the news of the overwhelming?
Faces on that Day will be shamed.
Laboring and exhausted.
Roasting in a scorching Fire.
Given to drink from a flaming spring.

verses.arabic: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
verses.indopak: لَيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنۡ ضَرِيۡعٍۙ‏
verses.english: They will have no food except thorns.

verses.arabic: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
verses.indopak: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِيۡ مِنۡ جُوۡعٍؕ‏
verses.english: That neither nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.
Faces on that Day will be joyful.
Satisfied with their endeavor.
In a lofty Garden.
In it you will hear no nonsense.
In it is a flowing spring.
In it are raised beds.
And cups set in place.
And cushions set in rows.
And carpets spread around.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
verses.indopak: اَفَلَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَي الۡاِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡࣟ‏
verses.english: Do they not look at the camels—how they are created?
And at the sky—how it is raised?
And at the mountains—how they are installed?
And at the earth—how it is spread out?
So remind. You are only a reminder.
You have no control over them.
But whoever turns away and disbelieves.
Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
To Us is their return.
Then upon Us rests their reckoning.
By the daybreak.
And ten nights.
And the even and the odd.
And the night as it recedes.

verses.arabic: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
verses.indopak: هَلۡ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِيۡ حِجۡرٍؕ‏
verses.english: Is there in this an oath for a rational person?

verses.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.indopak: اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍۙࣕ‏
verses.english: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Aad?
Erum of the pillars.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
verses.indopak: الَّتِيۡ لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي الۡبِلَادِۙࣕ‏
verses.english: The like of which was never created in the land.
And Thamood—those who carved the rocks in the valley.
And Pharaoh of the Stakes.
Those who committed excesses in the lands.
And spread much corruption therein.
So your Lord poured down upon them a scourge of punishment.
Your Lord is on the lookout.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
verses.indopak: فَاَمَّا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ فَاَكۡرَمَهٗ وَنَعَّمَهٗ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَكۡرَمَنِؕ‏
verses.english: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and honors him, and prospers him, he says, “My Lord has honored me.”

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا٘ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰىهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهٗ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَهَانَنِۚ‏
verses.english: But whenever He tests him, and restricts his livelihood for him, he says, “My Lord has insulted me.”
Not at all. But you do not honor the orphan.
And you do not urge the feeding of the poor.
And you devour inheritance with all greed.
And you love wealth with immense love.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
verses.indopak: كَلَّا٘ اِذَا دُكَّتِ الۡاَرۡضُ دَكًّا دَكًّاۙ‏
verses.english: No—when the earth is leveled, pounded, and crushed.
And your Lord comes, with the angels, row after row.

verses.arabic: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَجِايۡٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ࣢ۙ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّتَذَكَّرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ وَاَنّٰي لَهُ الذِّكۡرٰيؕ‏
verses.english: And on that Day, Hell is brought forward. On that Day, man will remember, but how will remembrance avail him?
He will say, “If only I had forwarded for my life.”
On that Day, none will punish as He punishes.
And none will shackle as He shackles.
But as for you, O tranquil soul.
Return to your Lord, pleased and accepted.
Enter among My servants.
Enter My Paradise.
I swear by this land.
And you are a resident of this land.
And by a father and what he fathered.
We created man in distress.

verses.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
verses.indopak: اَيَحۡسَبُ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ اَحَدٌۘ‏
verses.english: Does he think that no one has power over him?
He says, “I have used up so much money.”
Does he think that no one sees him?
Did We not give him two eyes?
And a tongue, and two lips?
And We showed him the two ways?
But he did not brave the ascent.
And what will explain to you what the ascent is?
The freeing of a slave.

verses.arabic: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
verses.indopak: اَوۡ اِطۡعٰمٌ فِيۡ يَوۡمٍ ذِيۡ مَسۡغَبَةٍۙ‏
verses.english: Or the feeding on a day of hunger.
An orphan near of kin.
Or a destitute in the dust.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡمَرۡحَمَةِؕ‏
verses.english: Then he becomes of those who believe, and advise one another to patience, and advise one another to kindness.
These are the people of happiness.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا هُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِؕ‏
verses.english: But as for those who defy Our revelations—these are the people of misery.
Upon them is a padlocked Fire.
By the sun and its radiance.
And the moon as it follows it.
And the day as it reveals it.
And the night as it conceals it.
And the sky and He who built it.
And the earth and He who spread it.
And the soul and He who proportioned it.
And inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness.
Successful is he who purifies it.
Failing is he who corrupts it.
Thamood denied in its pride.
When it followed its most wicked.

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
verses.indopak: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلُ اللّٰهِ نَاقَةَ اللّٰهِ وَسُقۡيٰهَاؕ‏
verses.english: The messenger of Allah said to them, “This is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink.”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.indopak: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَعَقَرُوۡهَا ࣢ۙࣕ فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ بِذَنۭۡ بِهِمۡ فَسَوّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
verses.english: But they called him a liar, and hamstrung her. So their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled it.
And He does not fear its sequel.
By the night as it covers.
And the day as it reveals.
And He who created the male and the female.
Your endeavors are indeed diverse.
As for him who gives and is righteous.
And confirms goodness.
We will ease his way towards ease.
But as for him who is stingy and complacent.
And denies goodness.
We will ease his way towards difficulty.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُ مَالُهٗ٘ اِذَا تَرَدّٰيؕ‏
verses.english: And his money will not avail him when he plummets.
It is upon Us to guide.
And to Us belong the Last and the First.
I have warned you of a Fierce Blaze.
None will burn in it except the very wicked.
He who denies and turns away.
But the devout will avoid it.
He who gives his money to become pure.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: وَمَا لِاَحَدٍ عِنۡدَهٗ مِنۡ نِّعۡمَةٍ تُجۡزٰ٘يۙ‏
verses.english: Seeking no favor in return.
Only seeking the acceptance of his Lord, the Most High.
And he will be satisfied.
By the morning light.
And the night as it settles.
Your Lord did not abandon you, nor did He forget.
The Hereafter is better for you than the First.
And your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied.
Did He not find you orphaned, and sheltered you?
And found you wandering, and guided you?
And found you in need, and enriched you?
Therefore, do not mistreat the orphan.
Nor rebuff the seeker.
But proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
Did We not soothe your heart?
And lift from you your burden.
Which weighed down your back?
And raised for you your reputation?
With hardship comes ease.
With hardship comes ease.
When your work is done, turn to devotion.
And to your Lord turn for everything.
By the fig and the olive.
And Mount Sinai.
And this safe land.

verses.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
verses.indopak: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ فِيۡ٘ اَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيۡمٍؗ‏
verses.english: We created man in the best design.
Then reduced him to the lowest of the low.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍؕ‏
verses.english: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds; for them is a reward without end.
So why do you still reject the religion?
Is Allah not the Wisest of the wise?
Read: In the Name of your Lord who created.
Created man from a clot.
Read: And your Lord is the Most Generous.
He who taught by the pen.
Taught man what he never knew.
In fact, man oversteps all bounds.
When he considers himself exempt.
But to your Lord is the return.
Have you seen him who prevents?
A servant when he prays?
Do you think he is upon guidance?
Or advocates righteousness?
Do you see how he disbelieved and turned away?
Does he not know that Allah sees?

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
verses.indopak: كَلَّا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ يَنۡتَهِ ࣢ۙ لَنَسۡفَعًاۭ بِالنَّاصِيَةِۙ‏
verses.english: No. If he does not desist, We will drag him by the forelock.
A deceitful, sinful forelock.
Let him call on his gang.
We will call the Guards.
No, do not obey him; but kneel down, and come near.
We sent it down on the Night of Decree.
But what will convey to you what the Night of Decree is?

verses.arabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
verses.indopak: لَيۡلَةُ الۡقَدۡرِ ࣢ۙ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اَلۡفِ شَهۡرٍؕؔ‏
verses.english: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
verses.indopak: تَنَزَّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَالرُّوۡحُ فِيۡهَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ اَمۡرٍۙۛ‏
verses.english: In it descend the angels and the Spirit, by the leave of their Lord, with every command.
Peace it is; until the rise of dawn.

verses.arabic: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
verses.indopak: لَمۡ يَكُنِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَالۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ مُنۡفَكِّيۡنَ حَتّٰي تَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡبَيِّنَةُۙ‏
verses.english: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, were not apart, until the Clear Evidence came to them.

verses.arabic: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ
verses.indopak: رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ يَتۡلُوۡا صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةًۙ‏
verses.english: A messenger from Allah reciting purified scripts.
In them are valuable writings.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
verses.indopak: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ الۡبَيِّنَةُؕ‏
verses.english: Those who were given the Scripture did not splinter, except after the Clear Evidence came to them.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
verses.indopak: وَمَا٘ اُمِرُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ۙ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤۡتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَذٰلِكَ دِيۡنُ الۡقَيِّمَةِؕ‏
verses.english: They were commanded only to worship Allah, devoting their faith to Him alone, and to practice regular prayer, and to give alms. That is the upright religion.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَالۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ فِيۡ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ الۡبَرِيَّةِؕ‏
verses.english: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, will be in the Fire of Hell, where they will abide forever. These are the worst of creatures.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ الۡبَرِيَّةِؕ‏
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life—these are the best of creatures.

verses.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
verses.indopak: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَبَدًاؕ رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُوۡا عَنۡهُؕ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهٗࣖ‏
verses.english: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eternity beneath which rivers flow, where they will abide forever. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever fears His Lord.
When the earth is shaken with its quake.
And the earth brings out its loads.
And man says, “What is the matter with it?”
On that Day, it will tell its tales.
For your Lord will have inspired it.

verses.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
verses.indopak: يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّصۡدُرُ النَّاسُ اَشۡتَاتًا ࣢ۙ لِّيُرَوۡا اَعۡمَالَهُمۡؕ‏
verses.english: On that Day, the people will emerge in droves, to be shown their works.

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
verses.indopak: فَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرًا يَّرَهٗؕ‏
verses.english: Whoever has done an atom's weight of good will see it.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
verses.indopak: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَّرَهٗࣖ‏
verses.english: And whoever has done an atom's weight of evil will see it.
By the racers panting.
Igniting sparks.
Raiding at dawn.
Raising clouds of dust.
Storming into the midst.
Indeed, the human being is ungrateful to his Lord.
And he bears witness to that.
And he is fierce in his love of wealth.

verses.arabic: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
verses.indopak: اَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ اِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي الۡقُبُوۡرِۙ‏
verses.english: Does he not know? When the contents of the graves are scattered around.
And the contents of the hearts are obtained.
Their Lord, on that Day, is fully informed of them.
The Shocker.
What is the Shocker?
What will explain to you what the Shocker is?
The Day when the people will be like scattered moths.
And the mountains will be like tufted wool.
As for he whose scales are heavy.
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for he whose scales are light.
His home is the Abyss.
Do you know what it is?
A Raging Fire.
Abundance distracts you.
Until you visit the graveyards.
Indeed, you will know.
Certainly, you will know.
If you knew with knowledge of certainty.
You would see the Inferno.
Then you will see it with the eye of certainty.
Then, on that Day, you will be questioned about the Bliss.
By Time.
The human being is in loss.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡحَقِّ ࣢ۙ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِࣖ‏
verses.english: Except those who believe, and do good works, and encourage truth, and recommend patience.
Woe to every slanderer backbiter.
Who gathers wealth and counts it over.
Thinking that his wealth has made him immortal.
By no means. He will be thrown into the Crusher.
And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
Allah's kindled Fire.
That laps to the hearts.
It closes in on them.
In extended columns.

verses.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
verses.indopak: اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِاَصۡحٰبِ الۡفِيۡلِؕ‏
verses.english: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?
Did He not make their plan go wrong?
He sent against them swarms of birds.
Throwing at them rocks of baked clay.
Leaving them like chewed-up leaves.
For the security of Quraish.
Their security during winter and summer journeys.
Let them worship the Lord of this House.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡ٘ اَطۡعَمَهُمۡ مِّنۡ جُوۡعٍ ࣢ۙ وَّاٰمَنَهُمۡ مِّنۡ خَوۡفٍࣖ‏
verses.english: Who has fed them against hunger, and has secured them against fear.
Have you considered him who denies the religion?
It is he who mistreats the orphan.
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray.
Those who are heedless of their prayers.
Those who put on the appearance.
And withhold the assistance.
We have given you plenty.
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice.
He who hates you is the loser.
Say, “O disbelievers.
I do not worship what you worship.
Nor do you worship what I worship.
Nor do I serve what you serve.
Nor do you serve what I serve.
You have your way, and I have my way.”
When there comes Allah’s victory, and conquest.

verses.arabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
verses.indopak: وَرَاَيۡتَ النَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ فِيۡ دِيۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَفۡوَاجًاۙ‏
verses.english: And you see the people entering Allah’s religion in multitudes.

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
verses.indopak: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُؕؔ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًاࣖ‏
verses.english: Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and seek His forgiveness. He is the Accepter of Repentance.
Condemned are the hands of Abee Lahab, and he is condemned.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.indopak: مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَمَا كَسَبَؕ‏
verses.english: His wealth did not avail him, nor did what he acquired.
He will burn in a Flaming Fire.
And his wife—the firewood carrier.
Around her neck is a rope of thorns.
Say, “He is Allah, the One.
Allah, the Absolute.
He begets not, nor was He begotten.
And there is nothing comparable to Him.”
Say, “I take refuge with the Lord of Daybreak.
From the evil of what He created.
And from the evil of the darkness as it gathers.
And from the evil of those who practice sorcery.
And from the evil of an envious when he envies.”
Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
The King of mankind.
The God of mankind.
From the evil of the sneaky whisperer.
Who whispers into the hearts of people.
From among jinn and among people.”
